gloss: unprecedented and unrepeatable; the first and last of its kind

definitions.gloss: unprecedented and never to be repeated; utterly unparalleled
definitions.explanation: A four-character idiom ({四字熟語|よじじゅくご}) describing something so extraordinary that nothing like it has happened before ({空前|くうぜん}, never seen before) and nothing like it will happen again ({絶後|ぜつご}, none after). Usually used with の before a noun.

examples.japanese: {空前絶後|くうぜんぜつご}の{大|だい}ヒットだ。
{空前絶後|くうぜんぜつご}の{規模|きぼ}のイベントが{開|ひら}かれた。
examples.english: An event of unprecedented scale was held.

examples.japanese: その{記録|きろく}は{空前絶後|くうぜんぜつご}と{言|い}われ、{今|いま}でも{破|やぶ}られていない。
examples.english: That record is said to be unprecedented and unlikely ever to be matched, and it still has not been broken.

notes:
A {四字熟語|よじじゅくご} meaning that something is the first of its kind and will never be matched. Composed of {空前|くうぜん} (never seen before) and {絶後|ぜつご} (never to occur again). Most often used with の: {空前絶後|くうぜんぜつご}の.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {空前絶後|くうぜんぜつご}の{大|だい}ヒット: an unprecedented huge hit
- {空前絶後|くうぜんぜつご}の{出来事|できごと}: a once-in-history event

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {前代未聞|ぜんだいみもん}: unheard-of — stresses never having been heard of before, without the "never again" half
